evidence: Carries the RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies error handling in the `dumptxoutset` RPC.
rationale: Prevents a node crash by returning a pruning error instead of hitting an assertion failure during `dumptxoutset` rollback on a pruned assumeutxo node. According to the PR description, "Loading a UTXO snapshot on a pruned node can leave the active tip without block or undo data. Attempting a rollback with `dumptxoutset` then triggers an assertion and terminates the node."
